prompt: Complete B2.7 Scoped Commit & PR Validation. Commit the B2.6 working tree by ownership, construct a clean under-100-file stacked PR series, remove the unpublished pnpm-lock delta, use the repository PR template, observe remote CI and review state, and do not merge or ship.
allowed_actions: Create logical commits with the required co-author trailer
Create and rename descriptive codex/ branches
Replay unpublished commits without pnpm-lock.yaml while preserving all other work
Fetch, push, and create pull requests against iiwish/verrail
Fix in-scope CI or review failures and update the pull-request stack
Create B2.7 stack, receipt, evidence, timeline, and advisory review records
forbidden_actions: Add product functionality or broaden implementation scope
Reference private task ids or localhost URLs in public pull requests
Merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record
expected_evidence: Logical commit list and clean working tree
Stack manifest with pull-request bases, heads, file counts, and URLs
Proof that pnpm-lock.yaml is absent from every pull request
Remote CI and automated review results
stop_conditions: A pull request would exceed 99 changed files against its declared base
History replay would lose or silently change accepted implementation
A remote failure requires unrelated product work
A merge, deployment, release, or ship action would be required
